newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles names Turnbull new chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles names Turnbull new chairman.

text.p: Transport, logistics and security group Brambles Industries Ltd said on Friday it had appointed Andrew Turnbull as its new chairman following the retirement of Alan Coates who also retired from the board.
Brambles said the appointment would be effective from the day of the company's annual meeting on November 8.
Turnbull joined the Brambles board in August 1994 and was the managing director and chief executive of food group Burns Philp and Co Ltd from 1984 to 1994.
Turnbull is also on the boards of MIM Holdings Ltd, National Australia Bank Ltd and John Fairfax Holdings Ltd.
